benchmark_suite: VoltaLake Gold Layer Commercial Intelligence Benchmark
audit_status: Hand-written mock SQL and synthetic status entries deleted. Live benchmark requires active Databricks workspace credentials to execute via genie_evaluation_harness.py.
target_space: VoltaLake Executive & Commercial Propositions Genie Space

questions.question: What was the electricity switching rate in Ireland in 2022 according to CRU reports?

expected_metrics.citation: CRU Energy Monitoring Report for 2023 (CRU2024132), p.15 (like-for-like series: 2022 = 418,597 / 16.57%; 2022 report CRU202389 p.16 reported 418,595 / 19.51%)

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT switching_rate_pct, citation FROM voltalake.gold.fact_market_switching WHERE jurisdiction = 'IE' AND year = 2022;

questions.question: How did domestic switching rates compare between Ireland and Great Britain in 2023?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT jurisdiction, year, switching_rate_pct, source FROM voltalake.gold.fact_market_switching WHERE year = 2023 ORDER BY jurisdiction;

questions.question: What percentage of Irish electricity customers renegotiated contracts with their current supplier in 2023 without switching?

expected_metrics.citation: CRU Energy Monitoring Report for 2023, Executive Summary (p.3, p.14)

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT renegotiation_rate_pct, citation FROM voltalake.gold.fact_market_switching WHERE jurisdiction = 'IE' AND year = 2023;

questions.question: Which are the top 5 Irish counties ranked by retrofit propensity score?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT county, retrofit_propensity_score, propensity_tier FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie ORDER BY retrofit_propensity_score DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.question: What is the percentage of oil-dependent homes in County Donegal?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT county, pct_oil_dependent FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie WHERE county = 'Donegal';

questions.question: What is the average residential electricity consumption per dwelling in County Tipperary?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT county, residential_kwh_per_dwelling FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie WHERE county = 'Tipperary';

questions.question: What was the BEV share of new private car registrations in Dublin in 2025?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT county, bev_share_new_cars_pct FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie WHERE county = 'Dublin';

questions.question: Which Irish county had the highest BEV share of new car registrations in 2025?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT county, bev_share_new_cars_pct FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie ORDER BY bev_share_new_cars_pct DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What are the 3 customer personas identified from London smart meters and what is the evaluated silhouette score?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT persona_name, COUNT(*) as hh_count, AVG(avg_hh_kwh) as avg_kwh, AVG(peak_to_offpeak_ratio) as avg_ratio FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_customer_personas WHERE cluster >= 0 GROUP BY persona_name;

questions.question: What commercial proposition is targeted at the Dual-Peak Residential Consumer persona?

expected_metrics.target_proposition: Dynamic Time-of-Use Tariff & Smart Appliance Automation

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT persona_name, target_proposition FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_customer_personas WHERE persona_name LIKE '%Dual-Peak%';

questions.question: What was the Difference-in-Differences effect of the 2013 Time-of-Use tariff on peak demand compared to 2012 baseline?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT did_effect_kwh_hh, p_value, is_statistically_significant_0_05 FROM 'data/processed/tariff_response_statistical_findings.json';

questions.question: Under a €100,000 campaign spend with €5.50 cost per contact, what is the reach and acquired customer count at 3.5% conversion?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT contacts_reached, customers_acquired, cpa_eur, total_ltv_revenue_eur, roi_pct FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_campaign_roi_sensitivity WHERE marketing_spend_eur = 100000 AND conversion_rate = 0.035;

questions.question: What is the break-even conversion rate for the campaign simulator with €5.50 contact cost and €835.50 composite LTV?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT breakeven_conversion_rate_pct FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_campaign_roi_sensitivity;

questions.question: What was the evaluated pass rate for positive floor area in SEAI BER data?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT expectation_name, passed_records, failed_records, pass_rate_pct FROM voltalake.gold.data_quality_scorecard WHERE expectation_name = 'positive_floor_area';

questions.question: What is the SLA update frequency and status for CSO Table TEM27?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT source_system, update_frequency, sla_days, sla_status FROM voltalake.gold.freshness_tracking WHERE source_system LIKE '%TEM27%';

questions.question: Which GB Local Authority has the highest retrofit propensity score and what is its main driver?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT LA, Region, gb_retrofit_propensity_score, pct_e7_meters, domestic_mean_kwh FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_gb ORDER BY gb_retrofit_propensity_score DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What was SSE Airtricity's domestic electricity customer share and site count in Q4 2023 according to CRU reports?

expected_metrics.citation: CRU Energy Monitoring Report for 2023 (CRU2024132), Table on p.55

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT 253122 as sse_sites, 2231100 as total_sites, ROUND(253122.0 / 2231100.0 * 100, 2) as sse_share_pct;

questions.question: What was Electric Ireland's domestic electricity customer share in Q4 2023 according to CRU reports?

expected_metrics.citation: CRU Energy Monitoring Report for 2023 (CRU2024132), Table on p.55

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT 1168284 as ei_sites, 2231100 as total_sites, ROUND(1168284.0 / 2231100.0 * 100, 2) as ei_share_pct;

questions.question: How many administrative counties are conformed in the Irish retrofit propensity index and what are the lowest ranked counties?
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as county_count FROM voltalake.gold.kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie;

questions.question: What data protection measure is applied to household identifiers in the smart meter dataset under GDPR Article 25?

expected_metrics.protection_measure: Salted HMAC SHA-256 pseudonymisation with Unity Catalog dynamic column masking

questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT 'Salted HMAC SHA-256 pseudonymisation with Unity Catalog dynamic column masking' as gdpr_control;
